Jawa_HuttCartel.label: Hutt Cartel
Jawa_HuttCartel.description: Wealthy, decentralised and entirely transactional. The Cartel owns the oases and sells water at whatever the buyer can be made to pay, and it holds the only non-Imperial orbital node on the planet — the door off-world, and the reason everyone keeps taking its calls. It is hostile the way a creditor is hostile. Nothing about it is personal, and everything about it is negotiable. Jawa Patches (local)

OutlanderCivil.label: Homestead Defense League
OutlanderCivil.description:
The most numerous and least centralised faction on the world — farmers on the dry flats, living off whatever their vaporators pull out of the night air.

Decent, tired, and badly armed. They defend wells and they do not come looking for anyone.

Empire.label: The Galactic Empire
Empire.description: The occupier, and the only permanent enemy. Not hateful — procedural. Standardised infantry moved by drop-pod, security droids that were requisitioned rather than chosen, the rare Sith attached to nothing anyone can name, and a reach that is mostly orbital. It does not want this world. It wants what leaves this world on schedule. Royalty

Pirate.label: Blackstar Company
Pirate.description:
Not a faction so much as one dangerous person with a name who is coming for you.

Independent hunters bound by a professional code, taking contracts rather than pillaging. The distinction matters to them. It will not matter to you when they arrive.

Jawa_IndigenousTribes.label: Jawa Trade Moot
Jawa_IndigenousTribes.description: Clans of the deep sand who never took a ship. They keep the same nine gods and the same ledger as the crew of the Kolyska, and they will trade with anyone who does not look down at them for long. What they cannot buy they scavenge; what they cannot scavenge they remember the location of, and sell. Jawa Patches (local)
